result:
I’d make every person able to genuinely understand the lived experience of others—not just intellectually, but momentarily feel what they feel.

If that were built into human awareness, a lot of cruelty, indifference, and short-sighted systems would lose their foundation. Much of the world’s conflict and neglect comes from distance: from seeing other people as abstractions. Collapse that distance, and you change politics, economics, justice, and everyday life at once.
